title: Scores for the coach
prompt: A coach wants to see how each try at a lesson went. Write `solve(attempts)` so it returns `learner_id`, `lesson_id`, `attempt_no` and the score, with `score_pct` renamed to `score`.
rules: Return exactly four columns, in this order: `learner_id`, `lesson_id`, `attempt_no`, `score`.
`score` holds the values of `score_pct`, unchanged. A missing score stays missing.
hints: `select` returns the columns you list, in the order you list them.
You can mix plain names and `F.col(...)` in the same `select`.
